material.acceptance_criteria: Each team-strip hero dot carries a non-colour cue (a glyph, shape or short text) that shows alive or dead without hover, and the tooltip stays.
material.description: scenarios/moba/panels.lua:294 draws each hero dot as a label-less cell whose tone is 'ok' (alive) or 'bad' (dead). The state word appears only in the tooltip (tip), which needs a hover. A player who cannot tell green from red (WCAG 1.4.1 use of colour) cannot read a hero's state from the strip.
material.subject: Team strip shows each hero alive or dead only by colour
material.witness: Moot after hud-team-strip-dota-compact (22fc7e2d). Premise absent (codesearch dispatch 1792862298684-5417-6d8209739fe92e11): the strip has no per-hero dots; alive/dead/ok/bad tone terms occur only at 159-237, 333, 436 and 703, none inside team_tree (279-292). No strip element conveys hero state by colour.
material.witness_plan: Live match: view the team strip with colour vision simulated as deuteranopia; a dead hero must be distinguishable without hover.
